title: Hands-on with Kimi Code
summary: The same verified Python workflow as the flagship course — task contract, bounded change, objective verify.py evidence — taught hands-on in Kimi Code: built-in explore/plan/coder subagents keep reading, planning, and editing in separate lanes.
summaryZh: 与旗舰课程相同的已验证 Python 工作流——任务契约、有界改动、客观 verify.py 证据——在 Kimi Code 里实战：内置 explore/plan/coder 子代理把读、规划、改码分在三条道上。
outcome: The same tested report tool as the flagship course (identical contract and nine-test suite), driven through Kimi Code's subagent lanes — plus a survey-plan-edit workflow that transfers to any capable coding agent.
outcomeZh: 与旗舰课程相同的报表工具（同一契约、同一九测套件），改由 Kimi Code 的子代理分道驱动——外加一套可迁移到任何编码 Agent 的勘察-规划-编辑工作流。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
The kimi CLI installed and authenticated (a Moonshot/Kimi account or API key)
Comfort running shell commands; no Python packages are installed
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
已安装并完成认证的 kimi CLI（Moonshot/Kimi 账号或 API key）
能运行 shell 命令；无需安装任何 Python 包

lessons.title: Set up Kimi Code, install the FlyPython Skill, fetch the course
lessons.titleZh: 装好 Kimi Code、装上 FlyPython Skill、让 Agent 取回课程
lessons.objective: Start Kimi Code, authorize the FlyPython Skill, fetch this course's files, and run the starter's objective check.
lessons.objectiveZh: 启动 Kimi Code、授权 FlyPython Skill、取回本课文件，并运行 starter 的客观检查。

lessons.title: Write the task contract, plan it in the planning lane
lessons.titleZh: 写任务契约，在规划道里拆步
lessons.objective: Turn “make it better” into bounded, testable statements — then let the plan subagent decompose it before anything edits.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把「优化一下」变成有边界、可测试的陈述——再让 plan 子代理先拆步，然后才许动文件。

lessons.title: The bounded change, one contract line at a time
lessons.titleZh: 有界改动，一次一条契约行
lessons.objective: Supervise the coder lane through small edits — smallest change, no new dependencies, one failing test group at a time.
lessons.objectiveZh: 监督 coder 道逐个小编辑推进——最小变更、不新增依赖、一次一组失败测试。

lessons.title: Verify like a reviewer, not a spectator
lessons.titleZh: 像评审者一样验证，别当观众
lessons.objective: Complete the evidence loop — both verification directions, all three skins, a scope-creep diff review, and a written record of what is not proven.
lessons.objectiveZh: 完成证据闭环——双向验证、三个皮肤、范围蔓延 diff 审查，以及一份写明未证明内容的记录。

lessons.title: Take the workflow to your own project
lessons.titleZh: 把工作流带回自己的项目
lessons.objective: Port the workflow — not the code — to one script you own, with tests, a verify command, and honest limits.
lessons.objectiveZh: 迁移工作流——而不是代码——到你拥有的一个脚本上，附测试、验证命令与诚实的局限说明。

scenarios.title: Excel / report automation
scenarios.blurb: Turn a messy weekly orders export into a per-region sales summary.
scenarios.blurbZh: 把混乱的每周订单导出变成按区域汇总的销售摘要。

scenarios.title: Data monitor script
scenarios.blurb: Aggregate service latency numbers and isolate malformed readings.
scenarios.blurbZh: 汇总服务延迟数据，并隔离格式错误的读数。

scenarios.title: Small API tool
scenarios.blurb: Summarize ticket data pulled from an internal API (JSON input).
scenarios.blurbZh: 汇总从内部 API 拉取的工单数据（JSON 输入）。

verification.method: Identical contract and nine-test suite to the flagship course: the starter must reproduce seven named failures; the reviewed solution passes 9/9; your bounded change passes the same suite in lesson 3.
verification.methodZh: 与旗舰课程相同的契约与九测套件：starter 必须复现七个具名失败；已审核实现 9/9 通过；第 3 课中你的最小变更通过同一套件。

badge.nameEn: Reproduce with Kimi Code in the loop

levelZh: 对新手友好；需要读代码的耐心
